scope: Removal of redundant feed tabs below Stories

changes.summary: Create Hub now uses user-facing direct action labels: Deschide camera, Alege din galerie, Story, Clip, Tweet / postare, Drafturi and Live. Composer receives source metadata and displays source-specific guidance.
Social feed switcher includes Tweets as the last option and maps it to a dedicated tweets view.
Content starts directly below Stories; legacy feedTabs are hidden and the Pulse content area is expanded.
The Social feed endpoint accepts format=tweets.
The tweets format filters to text-only posts without media attachments.
Static audit expectations updated for social37, Tweets, direct Create Hub labels and removed data-format sub-tabs.

notes: Camera routes to openComposer('post', { camera: true, source: 'camera' }); on insecure mobile HTTP it falls back to native capture picker with capture=environment.
Gallery routes to openComposer('post', { pick: 'all', source: 'gallery' }) and launches the native photo/video picker.
Story routes to openComposer('story', { pick: 'all', source: 'story' }) and opens the story composer with media picker and duration controls.
Automation intentionally did not click Camera/Gallery native pickers to avoid blocking the browser on OS permission/file dialogs.
